units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3:1">Num. R. s. 3</cite>, beg. <he>לולבין לה׳</he> the branches are employed (on Succoth) for reciting Hallel with them. [<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3:1">Ib.</cite>, a. e. <he>להַלֵּל</he>.]
Ber. 35ᵃ (ref. to the plural הלולים, Lev. XIX, 24) אייתר ליה חד ה׳ לברכה one hillul is remained over to be employed as an intimation that you must give praise (when drinking wine).—Pl. הִילּוּלִים.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 32a:17">R. Hash. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>עשרה ה׳</he> ten times <he>הלל</he> in <cite ref="Psalms 150">Ps. CL</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 21b:6">Meg. 21ᵇ</cite> (omitted in Ms. M., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).—
Pes. 117ᵃ hal’luyah means הללוהו בהי׳ הרבה praise him with many praises.
